programme.title: Kyle Kinane: Dirt Nap
programme.desc: Kinane explores tolerance and returning to his roots with self-deprecating humor, mining comedy from his suburban life after years on the road — from vegan quesadillas to the Fast and Furious franchise to life with a wayward cat.

programme.title: Matt Rife: Only Fans
programme.desc: Matt Rife's debut stand-up special, a culmination of his first ten years doing comedy starting at age 15. Fan-funded and self-produced, it showcases his sharp crowd work, edgy humor, and personal storytelling.

programme.title: Paul Foot: Dissolve
programme.desc: Paul Foot's most personal show ever. In 2022 something momentous changed for him, and in Dissolve he reveals how he discovered the secret of life — with inevitable detours through King Tutankhamun, Sir Cliff Richard, and officious lollipop ladies.

programme.title: Trae Crowder: Trash Daddy
programme.desc: Rural Tennessee's Trae Crowder brings his erudite-yet-trailer'y perspective to life, fatherhood, and America in the 2020s — from his experience as a displaced hillbilly in Hollywood to rednecks' complicated relationship with aliens.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes: Say I Won't
programme.desc: Filmed at the historic Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Anjelah Johnson-Reyes delivers her sixth stand-up special, covering big life moves, getting older, and the evolving stages of marriage, family, and friendship.

programme.title: Kelsey Cook: Mark Your Territory
programme.desc: Kelsey Cook recently relocated to Minnesota in the dead of winter to move in with her boyfriend. She covers the perks of dating an older man, the chaos of IUD insertions, navigating a parent with dementia, and much more.

programme.title: Matt Rife: Matthew Steven Rife
programme.desc: In his second self-produced hour special, built by friends and fans, Matt pushes comedic boundaries with stories, improv, and positive messages. A charismatic look into his wit, sharp humor, and crowd-driven energy.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jan's seven-year-old son Cody begins communicating with an imaginary friend who lives in a red box in a nearby cemetery. Feeling helpless and desperate to protect her son, Jan contacts a shaman.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the banks of the Licking River, club owner Bobby Mackey has heard tales that the river draws murderers as well as Satanists to the area and that there have been times when the waters ran red with blood.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A session with a Ouija board transforms Marie's home into a portal for the diabolical. The family realizes that the evil can lurk in the most ordinary places - and in the most innocent people.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: With their first child on the way, Deb and Tony move in Atchison, Kansas. But when their son is born, the child's toys seem to take on a life of their own and strange whispers torment Tony.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, an American family refuses to believe there are ghosts in their house until their daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest explains that their house has been designed to empower the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Brookfield, Connecticut, young David suffers from intense nightmares and is physically attacked by an invisible entity. Paranormal investigators make contact with a legion of demons inside the child's body.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: An enigmatic photo of her boyfriend's brother killed in Vietnam entrances Lisa. As her obsession grows, she realizes that the spirit of the dead soldier is taking control of their lives.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Clara and her family move into a small home in rural Hinsdale, New York, they realize that the peace of life in the country is merely an illusion - and the threat of death is very real.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ed and Beth's ranch house seems like the perfect place to raise their toddler until they discover that they are not alone. A dark, heavy mist hangs over the house and grows larger day by day.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Following the breakup of his marriage, Steven LaChance begins to experience strange things inside his house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Mike and his girlfriend Lisa move in their new house, Lisa's personality begins to change dramatically.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Randy recites an incantation from a book on witchcraft, hoping to make contact with spirits of the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in the same townhouse in the city of Galway, Irelan, for decades. But when a new baby arrives, he stirs up the psychic energy of a terrible crime committed many years ago.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When April James and her fiance Matt buy a historic home in Salt Lake City, Utah, they immediately begin extensive work to make it their own, unaware of a ghostly inhabitant that detests change.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Mary Vogel has been a spiritual counselor for ten years, but a recent encounter with the demonic forces her to question everything she knows and trusts. Only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Sarah Miller perceives that something supernatural lurks inside her new home, terrorizing her children.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Bobby and Addie Wilcott buy an historic house in New England, but experts discover a demonic presence.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Unsettling nightmares of a dark, angry figure plague Cindy as she prepares to move her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Soon after they settle in, reality begins to mirror her nightmares.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Since childhood, Rebecca has been able to see and hear spirits but has blocked their attempts to communicate.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Bill and Myrisa Spencer's new apartment is anything but quiet. Ghostly figures emerge from the shadows to roam the halls. Unable to break their lease, they are forced to coexist with the spirits.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley buy an abandoned farm in New Hampshire. But soon, Joanne senses a negative presence nearby. When the presence turns physical, she calls on a Shamballa master.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Soon after the Shea family moves into an old home, eerie noises and ghostly voices puncture the quiet nights.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Shortly after moving in Vermont, the Johnson's daughter reveals that two fairies visit her room each night.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Stacy Jones has dedicated her life to helping others understand and cope with paranormal threats. When she witnesses a demon attacking her son, she enlists her colleague John Zaffis to save her son.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A shadowy presence manifests from the darkened corners of Judy McCarthy's Texas home. Over time, the ghost focuses its wrath on the McCarthy's beautiful teenage daughter, Caressa, and grows stronger.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Eddie Benitez fears the spirit of a dead man who committed suicide is slowly killing his son. He turns to his Puerto Rican roots to combat the deadly ghost and save his family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Morgan Knudsen and her friend Bob move into a flat in Edmonton. When a ghost attacks her, she calls in a demonologist who reveals the entity is trying to drive her out so that it can possess Bob.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats hopes life will change for the better when she marries her boyfriend Brian.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A nightmare starts when Chris starts renovating his family dream house - with a haunting ghost. Only with the help of paranormal investigators, priests, psychics and shamans does Chris figure out a way to protect his family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Faced with a supernatural threat, Betty Johnson and her family move, hoping to leave their troubles behind.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Connecticut child safety specialist Bob Baker has devoted his life to protecting children from natural and supernatural harm. When his mother starts hearing voices in his childhood home, Bob is faced with a demon that evolves from his own nightmares.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The VanLandingham family moves to a larger house in the small town of Wynne, Arkansas. What they first consider "house-settling" noise and behavior quickly turn into a full-scale, supernatural physical attack on both daughters Brianna and Heather.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Professor Mark Spencer and his wife Rebecca have just purchased the historic Allen House in Arkansas. Shortly after moving in, Rebecca encounters a faceless spirit. Mark calls investigators to determine whether the spirit means them harm.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Connecticut natives Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic restaurant, thinking it will be an adventure.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Victoria Dane was accidently overdosed before an emergency surgery and flatlined for more than seven minutes.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Stephanie rejects a friend's advances, he steals a piece of her hair and threatens to put a spell on her.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Mark Corvo finds a ceremonial alter in his attic. He reaches out to the Ghosts of New England Research Society for professional help. They believe tenants dabbling in the dark arts opened a portal to the other side and drew spirits to the location.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: During a home renovation, Debbie accepts the old house has a ghost and they will have to live with it.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After moving in their dream home, Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero begin to experience strange occurrences, mysterious footsteps and unexplained noises. When Lillian is physically attacked while sleeping, the couple tries to escape.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Tim Yancey and his older brother Tom love playing in the woods surrounding their Florida home. One afternoon, Tom senses a presence watching him from within the shadows. Days later, the same entity confronts Tim and chases him through the woods.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In the small town of Garden Grove, Iowa, Jennifer and Norman Rice purchase a majestic 19th-century mansion. Soon after, Jennifer and their son Andrew begin experiencing paranormal activities while Norman is out of town on business.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When John Drenner Jr. finds a Satanic bible, he unwittingly unleashes a sinister demon. The entity threatens John with violent physical attacks. Minister Bill Bean must act swiftly to perform a powerful exorcism.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke's family finds their dream home along the waterfront in Florida - little do they know something dark is lurking in the house. What starts as strange noises escalates to physical attacks.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Shortly after Alicia and Scott move into a farmhouse, they learn it was the site of a murder decades earlier.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fox family moves into a large old house in Lowell, Arkansas. Soon after, an angry ghost begins to target the children, in their waking hours and in their dreams. The Fox family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst nightmares.

programme.desc: Recently cleared of an embezzlement charge, Detective Williams (Marcus D Spencer) is handed a high-profile murder case while also forced to take on a new partner. Williams is trying to solve this case while also working to see if he can trust his partner.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Afghanistan, South Africa, India
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 New Zealand, Scotland, Australia
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape: Episode 1
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape: Episode 2
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Children of the Sun - Butterflies
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Soomaa National Park, Estonia
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Gauja National Park, Latvia
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Lahemaa National Park, Estonia
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Soomaa National Park, Estonia
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Gauja National Park, Latvia
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Lahemaa National Park, Estonia
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon...

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Harbin: Moscow of the Orient
programme.desc: This episode shows Harbin's century-old Central Street brimming with exotic charm, unique Chinese Baroque architecture and authentic exquisite Russian food.We enjoy drinks at the annual Harbin Beer Festival and taste the exclusive Northern-style Manchu-Han Feast. At Volga Manor, we appreciate classic Russian architecture and folk customs from all over the world. It vividly presents Harbin, a city combining Northeast Chinese features and profound Russian cultural heritage.

programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder. Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden's journey as we explore his life in rural China.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. This episode comprehensively showcases the profound historical and cultural heritage of Dazu and its vibrant contemporary folk customs, exploring the thematic connotations, artistic characteristics and historical origins of the Dazu Stone Carvings, as well as their far-reaching influence on the...

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder. Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden's journey as we explore his life in rural China.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest-tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture. This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes - heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment - revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Aerial China IV: Guangxi

programme.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.5
programme.desc: In China, the chili pepper is an indispensable winter ingredient. Since its arrival in the Ming dynasty, the spicy staple has been reshaping Chinese food culture. programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest-tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture. This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes - heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment - revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Integration and Empowerment - A New Paradigm of Sino-German Cooperation Driven by Technological Innovation
programme.desc: For the first time, the Sino-German Forum on Cooperation and Development of New Energy Vehicles and the VDA Round Table of Presidents/CEOs of German Suppliers in China will be jointly held as a combined event during the World New Energy Vehicle Congress (WNEVC). The forum brings together industry leaders to explore collaborative development in the NEV sector, covering topics such as industry trends, innovation, policy frameworks, and international cooperation.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Integration and Empowerment - A New Paradigm of Sino-German Cooperation Driven by Technological Innovation
programme.desc: For the first time, the Sino-German Forum on Cooperation and Development of New Energy Vehicles and the VDA Round Table of Presidents/CEOs of German Suppliers in China will be jointly held as a combined event during the World New Energy Vehicle Congress (WNEVC). The forum brings together industry leaders to explore collaborative development in the NEV sector, covering topics such as industry trends, innovation, policy frameworks, and international cooperation.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Girl Asleep
programme.desc: The world is closing in on Greta Driscoll. On the cusp of turning fifteen she can't bear to leave her childhood, it contains all the things that give her comfort in this incomprehensible new world.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

programme.title: Father of Invention
programme.desc: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

programme.title: Switched
programme.desc: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: Becca, an anxious, non-vampire teen, is torn between two boys. Before she can choose, Becca must get around her controlling father, who embarrasses Becca by treating her like a child. Meanwhile, Becca’s friends contend with their own romantic issues, all of which collide at the prom.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: That Awkward Moment
programme.desc: When Mikey is dumped by his girlfriend, his best friends Jason and Daniel make a pact to remain single with him until he gets back into the whirlwind of the New York dating game.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: An action comedy in the vein of MIDNIGHT RUN about an ex-FBI agent (Jones) and an ex-mob lawyer in the witness protection program (Freeman) having to put aside their petty rivalry on the golf course to fend off a mob hit.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: When Chef Carl Casper suddenly quits his job at a prominent Los Angeles restaurant, he is left to figure out what’s next. Finding himself in Miami, he teams up with his ex-wife, his friend and his son to launch a food truck.

programme.title: Hesher
programme.desc: Starring Joseph Gordon Levitt, Natalie Portman and Rainn Wilson in a comedic, dark fairy tale about an eccentric, unhinged drifter who appears out of nowhere to help a struggling family deal with loss in the most unconventional of ways.

programme.title: Programming will resume shortly
programme.desc: We're catching up on our beauty sleep! Stay tuned for more priceless entertainment curated by Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse. When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Switched
programme.desc: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Super Fuzz
programme.desc: Stricken by radiation, an agent acquires superpowers with which he breaks up a gang of counterfeiters who print bills on a fishing boat that he disposes of along with frozen fish. Among the superpowers are bullets stopped with his teeth.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: When a young boy's mother dies, he invents an imaginary friend to accompany him to his new home far away. How can a boy be lonely with a gentle giant named Bogus? Gerard Depardieu and Whoopi Goldberg star together for the first time in this warmhearted tale of magic and fantasy.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: California King
programme.desc: When mattress store manager Perry's childhood crush Lynette announces she's leaving town, he panics. Desperate to prove himself, he and his reckless best friend Wyatt concoct a harebrained scheme to "rescue" her younger brother from a fake kidnapping—only to accidentally pull off a real one.

programme.title: Senior Moment
programme.desc: Stripped of his driver's license, a retired NASA pilot must not only battle with the DMV, he must find new ways to navigate love and life without his beloved vintage Porsche.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: After losing an audition for her dream job, Meghan Miles, a Los Angeles TV news anchor, goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying.

programme.title: Humor Me
programme.desc: A once-acclaimed New York playwright, Nate (Jemaine Clement), is struggling to finish his new play when his wife (Maria Dizzia) leaves him, taking their son.

programme.title: Father of Invention
programme.desc: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV; and worse than that, he’s white.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: Poms
programme.desc: POMS is an uplifting comedy about Martha a woman who moves into a retirement community and starts a cheerleading squad with her fellow residents, Sheryl, Olive and Alice, proving that it's never too late to follow your dreams.

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: Ellen Burstyn, James Caan, Ann-Margret, Jane Curtin and Christopher Lloyd star in this delightful comedy about a senior who moves into a retirement home full of lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments, bullying “mean girls”…and maybe even love.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse. When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

programme.title: Ride the Eagle
programme.desc: Leif (Jake Johnson) inherits a picturesque log cabin when his estranged mother Honey (Susan Sarandon) dies. But there is a condition; he must first complete her elaborate to-do list.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: Isaac is a man in free fall immobilized by mediocrity. His career is going nowhere. His blind girlfriend of ten years is leaving him. And his overbearing family doesn't help matters. What did he do to deserve this? Things were supposed to work out differently for him. Isaac Lachmann had big dreams.

programme.title: A Very Bad Day
programme.desc: During the course of one day, a group of teachers and parents find themselves caught up in a plot of sex, lies and dead bodies.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.sub-title: S00 : E01 GLORY 105: Last Heavyweight Standing Finals
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.sub-title: S00 : E02 GLORY 106: Last FW Standing Quarter Finals
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

As Pearl is torn between desire and danger, family tensions explode around her.

programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: Tequila Joe
programme.desc: A young deputy tries to sober and revitalize a washed up, alcoholic sheriff to take down a pair of warring gangs of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

programme.title: Belle Starr's Daughter
programme.desc: The daughter of famous outlaw Belle Starr arrives at the town where her mother was murdered to find her killer.

programme.title: The Relentless Four
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Sam Garrett sets out to clear Rex Calhoun’s name but is betrayed by four ruthless cowboys. Left for dead and later framed for murder, Garrett escapes jail only to find a bounty on his own head. Now hunted by killers and the law, he must fight to survive and uncover the truth.

programme.title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programme.desc: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.

programme.title: Long Days of Vengeance
programme.desc: After three years of brutal labor for a crime he didn't commit, ex-Sheriff Ted Barnett escapes prison to hunt down the three men who framed him for his father's murder. "Long Days of Vengeance" is a gripping spaghetti western about justice, revenge, and redemption under the scorching desert sun.

programme.title: The Star Packer

programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.title: Beyond The Law

As Stanton is replaced by a harsher commander, tensions rise, leading to disastrous consequences for both sides.

The police want to stop the tribes from attacking farmers, while the Yaqui seek revenge for bad medicine that blinded their children. Both groups capture the criminals but find themselves trapped by angry tribes at a ruined mission. Can cops and criminals unite to survive?

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Fall favourites are on display as chef Pino Di Cerbo shares magic autumn dishes. Beginning with Brussels sprouts, Pino serves them both roasted and fresh over creamy labneh with a funky black garlic dressing. Then, for a twist on regular risotto, Pino combines barley and celery to create a dish that is creamy and comforting. Autumn keeps falling in the next dish, a salad of butternuts, kale and a vibrant vinaigrette bursting with apple and ginger. For his fall finale, Pino creates mushrooms on toast with roasted mixed mushrooms in a rich sauce paired with gremolata and served hot on toasted focaccia!

programme.desc: To uncover how the mafia has worked in the UK, Ross heads to New York. Meeting Salvatore ‘Crazy Sal’ Polisi, a mafia enforcer in the 1970s, Ross learns how in the 1920’s British bootleggers exported alcohol to the US during prohibition.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
programme.desc: Ross starts his journey under the arches of Blackfriars bridge in London. In 1982, under this bridge a man was found. He had apparently hanged himself. The man was Roberto Calvi, better known as “God’s Banker".

programme.title: Myths & Monsters
programme.desc: How do communities form, survive and adapt? Explore how myths and legends shape societal rules and the punishments for those who break them.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 The End of All Things
programme.desc: Death is a frightening, unsettling prospect for us all. Myths and legends help explore those anxieties but they tell us about more than mortal fear alone.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
programme.desc: Going out on a raid with the army, Ross finds out just how prevalent cocaine is in Colombia. He then heads up into the mountains to hear about the Cali Cartel from the son of its founder.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Costa Del Crime
programme.desc: Ross starts his journey under the arches of Blackfriars Bridge in London. In 1982, under this bridge a man was found. He had apparently hanged himself. In his pockets he had five bricks and about US$14,000 in three different currencies.

programme.title: Digging For Britain
programme.sub-title: S04 : E02 The Battle of Waterloo
programme.desc: Alice Roberts and Matt Williams present more outstanding archaeology. The team unearths a mass grave and search the Thames for clues to a 17th century tragedy

programme.title: Digging For Britain

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Obsessions
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Reginald D Hunter on Class
programme.desc: Comedian Reginald D Hunter and Alexei Sayle peel away the thin veneer that disguises Britain's enduring class system.

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Obsessions
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Liza Tarbuck on Weather
programme.desc: Liza Tarbuck has long been fascinated by the weather and why Britons talk about it quite so much. Is it merely a pleasant way to pass the time, or is it much more important than that? And have weather apps made everyone self-proclaimed experts?

programme.title: Ramses The Great: King Of Ancient Egypt
